english.title: Intentionally obstruct an inspector appointed for the enforcement of the Animal Welfare Licensing of Activities Regs
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without lawful authority or excuse intentionally obstructed **(..SPECIFY NAME..), an inspector appointed for the purposes of the enforcement of the Animal Welfare (Licensing of Activities Involving Animals) (England) Regulations 2018 in the exercise of powers conferred by or under the Animal Welfare Act 2006
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 19 and 20(1)(b) and (2) of the Animal Welfare (Licensing of Activities Involving Animals) (England) Regulations 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
